hints.title: Linear Complexity Scaling
hints.text: For n up to one hundred thousand, the linear run length tracking approach scales naturally in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

hints.title: Consecutive Increment Invariant
hints.text: Whenever nums[i] == nums[i-1] + 1, increment the run length. Otherwise reset it to one.

hints.title: Direct Window Output
hints.text: At each endpoint i >= k - 1, output nums[i] if run length is at least k, else -1.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n * k) checks time out for n = 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains sliding window state in linear time.
